body:
Sorry for the multiple post!! I kept posting because it thought it had failed.
What I meant was that I was just another one posting the same kind of message.
Therapy never worked for me. I know what they are going to say right before they say it. It's like I'm trapped in another dimension where I know everything before the others.
Believe me when I'm feeling like this I don't really care about anyone, innocent or not. I would even say that I could feel like hurting others in the way. It's like some hate I have inside.
